definitions.gloss: tiptoe; tips of the toes; toe area
definitions.explanation: The front part of the foot, especially the tips of the toes. Also refers to the toe section of shoes or socks, and the act of standing or walking on tiptoe.

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}の{爪先|つまさき}がすり{減|へ}っている。
examples.english: The toes of my shoes are worn down.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんを{起|お}こさないように{爪先|つまさき}で{歩|ある}いて{部屋|へや}を{出|で}た。
examples.english: I tiptoed out of the room so as not to wake the baby.

notes:
USAGE:
{爪先|つまさき} is used both for the physical tip of the toes and for the act of tiptoeing. The phrase {爪先|つまさき}で{立|た}つ means "to stand on tiptoe" and {爪先|つまさき}で{歩|ある}く means "to walk on tiptoe."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爪先|つまさき}で{立|た}つ (to stand on tiptoe)
- {爪先|つまさき}で{歩|ある}く (to tiptoe / walk on tiptoe)
- {爪先|つまさき}が{冷|つめ}たい (the tips of one's toes are cold)
- {靴|くつ}の{爪先|つまさき} (the toe of a shoe)

WORD FORMATION:
{爪|つめ} (nail, claw) + {先|さき} (tip, point). Refers to the very end of the toes where the nails are.
